name: Whisker Mess
summary:
Get ready for a feline adventure filled with adorable pieces, clever combinations, and toys scattered everywhere in Whisker Mess! In this fun tile-fitting puzzle, you must place cat-shaped pieces across the board, create lines, and clear the way while earning points and making room for new moves.

By completing horizontal, vertical, and, on certain levels, even diagonal lines, you clear pieces, remove toys from the board, and turn every move into a new strategic opportunity. But be careful: blockers act as extensions of the walls and can completely change the way lines are formed!

With 30 levels divided into 3 biomes, Whisker Mess gradually introduces new challenges. As you progress, you'll encounter special toys with different behaviors, requiring you to carefully observe the board, adapt your plans, and discover how to make the most of each effect.

With no time pressure, Whisker Mess offers a relaxing and accessible experience, while still providing plenty of possibilities for those who enjoy thinking several moves ahead. With different board layouts, varied blockers, and combinations of special toys, each level brings a new challenge to test your creativity and spatial reasoning.

Fit the pieces, create lines, clear the mess, and help turn this feline chaos into pure fun!
